38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B

Thursday JANUARY 11, 2018
07:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.

8. Public Hearing
8A. Zoning Ordinance Amendment 17-002
City of Palmdale, Applicant
A request to amend the Palmdale Municipal Code to increase the allowable number of dogs and cats within residential and agricultural zones to increase consistency with the regulations for Los Angeles County.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2018-001 recommending that the City Council approve Zoning Ordinance Amendment 17-002, and find that the project is exempt from CEQA review. Megan Taggart, Senior Planner
8A
8B. Conditional Use Permit 98-12 Major Modification
Waste Management, Applicant
A request to allow an increase in waste tonnage from 1,800 tons per day to 3,600 tons per day and a 20 foot high litter fence located at the Antelope Valley Public Landfill 1200 West City Ranch Road, Palmdale, CA 93551.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission approve Conditional Use Permit 98-12 Major Modification and find that the project will not result in any changes to the previously adopted Environmental Impact Report for CUPÂ 98-12 on JuneÂ 9,Â 2011 Carlene Saxton, Senior Planner
8B
8C. Palmdale Transit Oriented Development Framework Plan Environmental Impact Report (EIR) 17-001
A request to certify an EIR for the Transit Oriented Development Land Use Framework Plan, which will guide the preparation of a Specific Plan for the project planning area, which is generally bounded by Rancho Vista Boulevard (Avenue P) to the north and Palmdale Boulevard (SR-138) to the south and by SR-14 to the west and 10th Street East to the east.Â  The EIR analyzed the maximum potential environmental impacts possible in order to clear the study area for adoption of a future Specific Plan and associated land use approvals.Â
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt a Statement of Overriding Considerations, adopt a Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program, and Certify the Final Environmental Impact Report (EIR 17-001) for the Palmdale Transit Oriented Development Framework Plan. Carlene Saxton, Senior Planner
8C
